title: 第13章 杀人如麻你怕了吗第14章 这模拟给他模爽了
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 【你没胡说，县令拿你当平账的冤大头，以前找不到凶手的案子全算你头上了。
【老刘听到你这话满脸不信，随意的翻了翻你的行李，找到了里面的判决文书。
【看完后，他嗤笑一声，起身把你的床铺的整整齐齐，顺手把旁边一哥们的被子挪到你床上。
【“陈老大你不知道，南边到了冬天也冷，这帮管军需的混蛋层层盘剥，发给我们的棉被里面摸不到几块棉花，你多盖一床省的冷。”
【被强行拿走被子的那哥们，一脸苦相。
【“老刘老大，我这……”
【“什么老大！
现在我是老二！
你和二牛盖一床，晚上一起睡还能互相取暖。”
【二牛一脸娇羞，点头道：“我反正行呢嘛……”
【见状，你觉得自己晚上睡觉得小心背后，不怕战友背后捅刀，就怕那不是刀。
【第四年，二十一岁。
（用不上的词条，六子就不写了，宝子们知道主角抽了就行~）
【凭借县衙判决文书里，那“杀了一百多人”
的官方背书，杂役营里的士兵都知道，你是个狠人。
【再加上你“不经意间”
展露一丝武者修为，威慑力更高了。
【他们不仅不敢招惹你，有时候还会讨好你。
【吃喝用度之类的，你几乎用不完。
【本来被充军的士兵，日子过的都挺艰苦，但你感觉却还行。
【如果能在军营里苟住，慢慢练功提升修为，多活一些岁月抽取词条，这一次模拟也算完成任务了。
【立功不立功的，你暂时倒是不考虑了。
【这可是冷兵器军队，什么功不用命拼才能拿到。
【不过，这是边军，面对南疆诸国的骚扰，出战在所难免。
content_en:
[You're not talking nonsense. The county magistrate took you for granted. All the cases where the murderer could not be found were blamed on you.
[Lao Liu looked disbelieving when he heard what you said. He rummaged through your luggage and found the judgment document inside.
[After reading it, he sneered, stood up, made your bed neatly, and moved the quilt of the buddy next to you onto your bed.
["Boss Chen, you don't know, it's cold in the south in the winter. These bastards in charge of military supplies are exploiting us at every level. There are not a few pieces of cotton in the quilts we were given. You can use an extra quilt to save yourself from the cold."
[The guy who had the quilt taken away by force had a grimace on his face.
["Boss Liu, I..."
[“What boss!
Now I'm the middle child!
You and Erniu share a bed, and you can keep each other warm when you sleep together at night. "
[Er Niu looked shy and nodded: "I can do it anyway..."
[Seeing this, you feel that you should be careful about your back when sleeping at night. You are not afraid of being stabbed in the back by your comrades, but you are afraid that it is not a knife.
[Fourth year, twenty-one years old.
(Liuzi won’t write down the entries that are not used. The treasurers just need to know that the protagonist smoked~)
[Based on the county government’s verdict document, it was stated that “more than a hundred people were killed”
With the official endorsement, all the soldiers in the handyman camp know that you are a ruthless person.
[Plus you "inadvertently"
Showing a trace of martial artist's cultivation will increase the intimidation power.
[Not only do they not dare to provoke you, but sometimes they even try to please you.
[You can hardly use up food and drink expenses and the like.
[Soldiers who were exiled originally had a very difficult life, but you feel that it is okay.
[If you can survive in the military camp, slowly practice to improve your cultivation, and live a few more years to extract entries, then this simulation can be considered as completing the task.
[Whether it’s meritorious or not, you don’t think about it for the time being.
[This is a cold-weapon army. You can't get anything without working hard.
[However, this is a frontier army. Facing harassment from the southern border countries, it is inevitable to go to war.
